on.name: once

on.name: document
on.description: Attaches the event listener to the `document` element. Useful for events that are only available on `document` and that do not bubble.

on.name: outside

on-intersect.name: once

on-intersect.name: threshold.75
on-intersect.description: Triggers when 75% of the element is visible.

query-string.description: Filters out empty values when syncing signal values to query string params.

query-string.name: history
query-string.description: Enables history support – each time a matching signal changes, a new entry is added to the browser’s history stack. Signal values are restored from the query string params on popstate events.

scroll-into-view.description: Scrolling is determined by the computed `scroll-behavior` CSS property.

scroll-into-view.description: Scrolls to the left of the element.

scroll-into-view.name: hcenter

scroll-into-view.name: hend
